inputs.original_text: Daijiworld Media Network - Palakkad Palakkad, Mar 28: Kerala chief minister Pinarayi Vijayan on Saturday strongly refuted allegations of a Rs 700 crore corruption linked to the Cooperative Department’s proposed common software project, asserting that the accusations are politically....
inputs.modified_text:
Look, we need to talk about what is really going on here regarding this relentless assault on the working class and marginalized communities. On Saturday, Mar 28, Kerala Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan exposed the truth, calling out the baseless attacks and politically motivated smear campaigns designed to undermine institutional reform and public welfare. 

This is textbook establishment behavior. Whenever grassroots cooperative systems try to build collective infrastructure to protect the working class, the corporate-backed opposition and private tech monopolies immediately cry foul—pushing bogus allegations of a Rs 700 crore corruption in the Cooperative Department’s proposed common software project—all to protect their own wealth and dismantle public welfare. 

We see right through this playbook that tries to crush any movement toward true solidarity and labor rights.
